*Last updated: 13 November 2026*

## 1. Controller

The controller responsible for data processing on this website, under the
EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), is:

Thomas M. Robotham\
c/o International Audio Laboratories Erlangen\
Am Wolfsmantel 33, 91058 Erlangen, Germany\
Email: [thomas.robotham@audiolabs-erlangen.de](mailto:thomas.robotham@audiolabs-erlangen.de)\
Phone: +49 9131 776-6747

This is a private website. The institute address is used only as a postal
address. The site is not operated by the International Audio Laboratories
Erlangen, FAU or Fraunhofer IIS. Their own privacy policies apply to their own
websites.

## 2. Summary

- This site uses no analytics, no tracking and no advertising, and sets no
  cookies.
- Like any website, it is delivered by a hosting provider, which processes
  your IP address to do so (section 3).
- Fonts, icons and scripts are served from this site itself. Opening a page
  contacts no other server.
- Videos and interactive 3D models load nothing from external servers until
  you click them (section 5).

## 3. Hosting and server log files

This site is hosted on **GitHub Pages**, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P.
Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you visit a page, GitHub
processes the data your browser sends in order to deliver it. This includes
your IP address, the date and time of the request, the page requested, your
browser type and operating system, and the referring page. GitHub may store
this information in server logs, for example for security purposes. I have no
access to these logs.

- **Legal basis:** Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. I have a legitimate interest in
  presenting my website reliably and securely.
- **Transfer to the USA:** GitHub is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy
  Framework (Art. 45 GDPR).
- **More information:** [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)

## 4. Cookies and local storage

This site sets **no cookies**.

Your browser's local storage keeps your display choices on your own device,
for example light or dark mode. This information is never sent to me or to
anyone else. You can delete it at any time in your browser settings. Storing
it is strictly necessary for the function you requested (§ 25 (2) no. 2
TDDDG).

## 5. Videos and 3D models (click to load)

**Videos** are hosted on YouTube, a service of Google Ireland Ltd., Gordon
House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. A page with a video shows only a
still image stored on this site. **No connection to YouTube is made until you
click the play button.** The video then loads from youtube-nocookie.com, and
Google receives your IP address and information about the page. Google may
also set cookies or use similar technologies, and may transfer data to the
USA. See the [Google privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

**Interactive 3D models** likewise show only a still image at first. When you
click one, your browser loads the 3D viewer library (three.js) from jsDelivr,
a service of Prospect One, Królewska 65A/1, 30-081 Kraków, Poland, delivered
through Cloudflare and Fastly. jsDelivr receives your IP address and the usual
request data (see section 3). See the
[jsDelivr privacy policy](https://www.jsdelivr.com/terms/privacy-policy-jsdelivr-net).
The model itself and any audio come from this site.

- **Legal basis:** Your consent, given by clicking (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR;
  § 25 (1) TDDDG). You can withdraw it at any time for the future by not
  starting further videos and by reloading the page.

## 6. External links

This site links to other websites, for example LinkedIn, Google Scholar,
ORCID, ResearchGate, publishers and doi.org. No data is sent to them until you
follow a link. From then on, the privacy policy of that site applies.

## 7. Contacting me by email

If you email me, for example about a student position, I process the data you
send. This includes your email address, your name, your message and any
attachments such as a CV. I use it only to answer your enquiry and to handle
your application.

- **Legal basis:** Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR where the enquiry relates to a
  potential position, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. I have a legitimate
  interest in answering enquiries.
- **Storage:** I use my work address at the International Audio Laboratories
  Erlangen (a joint institution of FAU and Fraunhofer IIS), so your email is
  received and stored on the institute's mail systems. Enquiries are deleted
  once they are no longer needed. Applications that are not successful are
  deleted six months after the position is filled, unless you agree to a
  longer period.

## 8. Your rights

Under the GDPR, you have the right to:

- **access** the personal data I hold about you (Art. 15),
- have it **corrected** (Art. 16) or **erased** (Art. 17),
- have its processing **restricted** (Art. 18),
- **data portability** (Art. 20),
- **object** to processing based on Art. 6 (1) (f) (Art. 21),
- **withdraw consent** at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7 (3)).

To exercise these rights, email me at the address above.

You also have the right to **lodge a complaint** with a data protection
supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for me is:

Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA)\
Promenade 18, 91522 Ansbach, Germany\
[www.lda.bayern.de](https://www.lda.bayern.de)

## 9. Changes

I will update this policy whenever the site changes in a way that affects
personal data.
